summary: Verified new Style Library export/import in TextEffectsPanel: export downloads webdojo-style-library.json (valid JSON array with {id,name,style,hover}), export button disabled on empty library and enabled after save; import merges new entries and toasts 'Imported N style(s)', re-uploading identical file toasts 'Nothing new to import' (dedupe by name+style+hover), invalid JSON object and malformed JSON both toast "That file isn't a valid Style Library export" and leave library intact; imported chip persists in localStorage 'webdojo_style_library' across reload. Light regression (save/apply/delete via chips) still OK. No console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: importLibrary uses `${Date.now()}-${randomSlice}` for ids inside a map — all imported entries share the same Date.now() timestamp and only differ by the 4-char random suffix, so a batch import could theoretically produce duplicate ids. Consider incorporating the index or crypto.randomUUID() for guaranteed uniqueness.
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral files /tmp/valid_import.json, /tmp/invalid_import.json, /tmp/malformed.json for import tests; used localStorage 'webdojo_style_library' entries 'MyNeon' (saved) and 'Imported Glow' (imported).
context_for_next_testing_agent:
Iteration 26 PASS matrix (0 console errors) — Style Library Export/Import:
- Empty lib: [data-testid=style-lib-export] is disabled; Import button + hidden input [data-testid=style-lib-import-input] present.
- Save style: Add block-cmp-header-lrg via mouse DnD from LeftSidebar to canvas-root, click canvas-el, open insp-tab-textfx, click textfx-static-neon → textfx-copy → fill style-lib-name='MyNeon' → style-lib-save → chip style-lib-lib-<ts> renders, export button enabled.
- Export: page.expect_download() → dl.suggested_filename == 'webdojo-style-library.json'. Downloaded file is a JSON array (len==1) whose entry has keys {id,name,style,hover} and name=='MyNeon'. Toast 'Exported 1 style' fires.
- Import valid: set_input_files on [data-testid=style-lib-import-input] with [{name:'Imported Glow',style:{...},hover:[]}] → chip count 1→2, new chip labeled 'Imported Glow', toast 'Imported 1 style'.
- Dedupe: uploading the SAME file again keeps chip count at 2 and shows toast 'Nothing new to import'.
- Invalid (non-array object {foo:1}) AND malformed JSON both produce toast "That file isn't a valid Style Library export" and library remains at 2 entries.
- Persistence: page.reload() → chip count still 2 and localStorage.getItem('webdojo_style_library') parses to array of 2 entries with names ['MyNeon','Imported Glow']. NOTE: canvas blocks themselves DO NOT persist across reload — if you need a selected element after reload you must re-add a block.
- Regression: style-lib-delete-lib-<id> still removes chip and clears localStorage entry. No console errors captured throughout.
DoM tip retained from iter 25: canvas-el-<id> wraps a Canvas.jsx <div dangerouslySetInnerHTML>; use n.querySelector('header') not firstElementChild.
rca_of_the_issue: No defects found. Implementation in TextEffectsPanel.jsx (exportLibrary at L266, importLibrary at L280) uses Blob + a.download for export and FileReader + JSON.parse + Array.isArray + style-shape validation + JSON-stringified-tuple dedupe set for import — matches spec.
